svg.text: 18 FeatherS3D survey carrier: the boards and devices that plug into it, lead by lead

g.text: plugs into J1, J2 on top
I2C2 STEMMA QT socket; JST-PH battery socket
header VBAT, GND for the shared cell
isolated: 24 V and 0V iso on the right
isolated: 5 V and 0V iso on the right

svg.text: Leads between the boards (FSD 40.2; the boards: docs/Method/project/fs3-survey-carrier.md)
Every lead is straight: pin 1 to pin 1. Qwiic leads: GND black, 3V3 red, SDA blue, SCL yellow. J8's 3V3 is left open.
Battery leads: JST-PH 2-way, either polarity (the switch path never touches GND); J26 takes jumpers or a DPST switch.
Shared cell (C-33.1): J27 (XH 2, F1 3 A) to the Notecarrier-X header VBAT and GND, at most 150 mm of 22 AWG or heavier;
then the Notecarrier has no cell of its own (J24, J25 and its LiPo socket empty) and nothing on its USB-C.
Field side: the add-on boards' terminals are isolated (0V iso, never the board's GND); each field cable passes a
surge protector at the enclosure wall, bonded to one earth rod (C-40.7), shields earthed at this end only (C-40.8).
Title bars: green = firmware on main; blue = in the FSD, not built yet; orange = proposed, not in the FSD.
